(async()=>{ __app.showTab('settings'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.key-row')].find(r=>r.firstChild.textContent==='Mute'); row.querySelector('.key-btn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const listening=row.querySelector('.key-btn').textContent; window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'x',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const row2=[...document.querySelectorAll('.key-row')].find(r=>r.firstChild.textContent==='Mute'); return listening + ' -> keys now: ' + [...row2.querySelectorAll('kbd')].map(k=>k.textContent).join(','); })()

(async()=>{ __app.showTab('player'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const v=__app.player.video; v.muted=false; document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'x',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const afterX=v.muted; document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'m',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); return 'X mutes: ' + afterX + ' | old M does nothing: ' + (v.muted===afterX); })()

(async()=>{ __app.showTab('settings'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.key-row')].find(r=>r.firstChild.textContent==='Snapshot'); row.querySelector('.key-btn').click(); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'x',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const keys=(n)=>[...[...document.querySelectorAll('.key-row')].find(r=>r.firstChild.textContent===n).querySelectorAll('kbd')].map(k=>k.textContent).join(',')||'(none)'; return 'toast: ' + document.getElementById('toast').textContent + ' | Snapshot: ' + keys('Snapshot') + ' | Mute: ' + keys('Mute'); })()

(async()=>{ const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.key-row')].find(r=>r.firstChild.textContent==='Reset view'); row.querySelector('.key-btn').click(); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Shift',shiftKey:true,bubbles:true})); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'R',shiftKey:true,ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const r2=[...document.querySelectorAll('.key-row')].find(r=>r.firstChild.textContent==='Reset view'); return [...r2.querySelectorAll('kbd')].map(k=>k.textContent).join(','); })()

(async()=>{ const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.key-row')].find(r=>r.dataset.btn==='0'); const sel=row.querySelector('select'); sel.value='mute'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); let pressed=false; navigator.getGamepads=()=>[{index:0,id:'Test pad',axes:[0,0,0,0],buttons:Array.from({length:16},(_,i)=>({pressed:i===0&&pressed,value:i===0&&pressed?1:0}))}]; pressed=true; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); pressed=false; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const hint=[...document.querySelectorAll('.muted.small')].find(x=>x.textContent.startsWith('You pressed'))?.textContent; __app.showTab('player'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const v=__app.player.video; v.muted=false; pressed=true; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); pressed=false; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); return 'in Settings: ' + hint + ' | in player, A now mutes: ' + v.muted; })()

(async()=>{ await vr180.setSettings({ theme: 'forest', keymap: {} }); const f='C:\\Users\\Owner\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\vr180-test.vr180backup'; await window.__backup.importBackup(f); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); const txt=m.querySelector('.backup-sum').innerText.split('\n').join(' '); await vr180.backupApply('merge'); const s=await vr180.getSettings(); m.close ? 0 : 0; document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); return 'summary: ' + txt + ' || after merge: theme=' + s.theme + ', mute keys=' + JSON.stringify(s.keymap.mute) + ', presets=' + s.picturePresets.map(p=>p.name).join(','); })()
